title: Short exactness of the same-universe free abelian torsor presentation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and $T$ a $G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor], with $X$ and all coefficient groups in universe $u$. Let $F$ be the sheafification of the sectionwise free abelian presheaf on $T$, and $R$ the sheafification of the sectionwise free abelian presheaf on pairs of sections of $T$. Define $d:R\to F$ by $(x,y)\mapsto[y]-[x]$, and $a:R\to G$ by sending $(x,y)$ to the unique $g$ such that $g+ x=y$. Set $E=F\amalg_R G$, let $\iota:G\to E$ be the second pushout inclusion, and let $p:E\to\mathbf Z_X$ be the morphism induced by the augmentation $[t]\mapsto1$ on $F$ and the zero map on $G$. Then $0\to G\xrightarrow{\iota}E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_X\to0$ is short exact. All constructions remain in coefficient universe $u$.

source.place: Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1), first construction by pushout of the free abelian sheaf; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02FQ

proof.text: Sheafify the free abelian presheaves on T and on T times T. The existing Torsor.pairsDiff sends (x,y) to [y]-[x], and Torsor.pairsSub sends it to the unique g with g + x = y. Form their pushout E with G. Augmentation sends every generator to 1 and kills pair differences, so pushout.desc defines p:E->Z_X with coefficient inclusion i satisfying i followed by p equals zero. These are real constructions, without any existence choices.

For every integer n and every local section t of T, n[t] lifts n through augmentation. The nonempty sieve of T covers every open. Thus augmentation is locally surjective, its sheafification is epi (Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff), and p is epi because augmentation factors through p.

Torsor.kernel_ι_pairsDiff_comp_pairsSub proves displacement kills the kernel of pair differences. Sheafification preserves kernels, via PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι. In the pushout square, Abelian.epi_kernel_map_of_isPushout gives an epi from the kernel of the difference map to the kernel of the coefficient inclusion. Its composite with the latter kernel inclusion is zero; cancelling that epi shows this inclusion is zero. Abelian.mono_of_kernel_ι_eq_zero then proves the coefficient inclusion is mono.

A sheaf morphism k out of the free sheaf killing pair differences has generator values invariant under the action of G. Torsor.exists_section_of_invariant glues them to a global section sigma of its codomain. On each open, n maps to n times the restriction of sigma; this is a natural additive morphism from the constant integer presheaf and descends by sheafifyLift. Equality on free generators proves that k factors through augmentation. For a morphism from E killing the coefficient inclusion, apply this factorization to its composite with the free-sheaf inclusion. pushout.hom_ext proves that it factors through p. Since p is epi, CokernelCofork.IsColimit.ofπ' gives that p is a cokernel of the inclusion. ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel gives exactness, and ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' combines exactness, mono and epi.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 02FQ, first construction; fully proved pair-relation presentation and cokernel argument implementing the free-abelian pushout construction
